name: Louisiana

agency.name: Louisiana Department of Conservation and Energy (formerly Department of Energy and Natural Resources), Office of Conservation

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill for Minerals
form.number: MD-10-R-1 (Rev 08/2009 body, footer Rev 10/25); amendments MD-10-R-A-1 and MD-10-R-AO
form.notes: Read the blank Excel form and its instruction sheet. Filed on buff paper in duplicate with the district office, with three original surveyor plats, the fee, financial security and Affidavit AFLN-1 (Rev 01/2024: surface-owner pre-entry notice and natural-gas management); permit valid 180 days. The form is one page: operator and code, parish and field codes, well name and number, section-township-range, location description, product, new/repermit/redrill/dual, straight/directional/horizontal, lease/unit, proposed MD and TVD, proposed zone, applicable orders, fee. No casing, cement, BOP, H2S, pit, water or frac fields. The agency page names no online filing for permits to drill; injection (UIC) applications use other forms not read.

api_number.n: API_NUM (14 digits); also an office-use box on MD-10-R-1

permit_number.n: WELL_SERIAL_NUM: the state serial number is the permit key (office-use box on form)

lease_name.n: LUW_NAME (production unit name, 110 of 304 recent) and LEASE_NUM (2 of 304); well name carries it

operator_id.n: ORGANIZATION_ID; form asks for the operator code number

operator_type.n: No business-type box on MD-10-R-1; operator registration (OR-1) not read

bond.n: Office-use box: financial security required prior to permitting, yes/no

district.n: DISTRICT_CODE (district office that takes the application)

field_pool.n: FIELD_NAME and FIELD_ID; SANDS and RESERVOIRS hold the zone

surface_latlon.n: SURFACE_LAT_DEC_DEG, SURFACE_LONG_DEC_DEG, plus Lambert and UTM X/Y

surface_plss.n: SECTION, TOWNSHIP, WELL_RANGE, MERIDIAN, LOCATION text; form asks section, township, range

bottom_hole_loc.n: Location description includes the bottom hole if applicable; layer holds surface points only

lateral_path.n: Form asks only Straight, Directional or Horizontal; no survey or path

elevation.n: No elevation box on MD-10-R-1; contents of the surveyor plat not read in full

surface_owner.n: Affidavit AFLN-1: surface owner given 30-day pre-entry notice, or an exemption box

well_type.n: PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE is 00 (none) on 145 of 173 permits in the last year; oil/gas known later

work_type.n: Boxes New Well, Repermit, Redrill (re-entry of plugged well), Dual; layer OPERATION_TYPE_CODE is 01 on all

well_direction.n: Boxes Straight, Directional, Horizontal; layer DIRWELL was empty on all 304 permits since 2025

proposed_depth_md.n: MEASURED_DEPTH filled on 304 of 304 permits since 2025; a permitted-not-drilled sample carries it

proposed_depth_tvd.n: TRUE_VERTICAL_DEPTH filled on 302 of 304 permits since 2025

target_formation.n: SANDS (122 of 304) and RESERVOIRS (106 of 304); FORMATIONS empty; form: proposed zone of completion

casing_program.n: Not on the form; LAC 43:XIX.103 lists no casing plan to file with the application

cement_program.n: Not on the form or in the filing rule

pressure_control.n: Not on the form or in the filing rule

h2s.n: Not on the form or in the filing rule

pit_waste.n: Not on the form or in the filing rule

water.n: Not on the form (box 'SPC Plan (on water)' is for wells drilled over water)

fracture_plan.n: Not on the form or in the filing rule

frac_dates.n: Frac page has no date field; work resume lists permitted-work dates, a frac may be one

frac_chemicals.n: WH-1 frac page asks each ingredient and CAS, or a public registry link (FracFocus); agency data holds none

frac_additives.n: WH-1 frac page asks trade name, supplier and purpose, or a registry link; agency data holds none

frac_amounts.n: WH-1 frac page asks maximum percent by mass per ingredient and base fluid volume; agency data holds none

spacing_unit.n: UNIT_WELL_FLAG (Y/N) only; the applicable conservation orders are written on the form

spacing_exception.n: No exception box on the form; 'applicable conservation orders' line may cite one

mineral_owner.n: Flags only: STATE_INTEREST_FLAG (22 of 304) and MINERAL_INTEREST_FLAG; no owner name

fee.n: Application fee and check number on form; amount set by depth under the fee order

notice_hearing.n: Surface-owner pre-entry notice (AFLN-1); no public comment period seen

date_received.n: Date of Application box; not a layer field

date_expires.n: Office-use 'Exp.' box; permit valid 180 days from issue per form instructions

plat_image.n: Plat required with application; whether plats are in the imaged well file not verified

form_image.n: SONRIS has an imaged well file by serial number; its contents were not verified (page gave 504)

completion_report.n: SONRIS Data Portal lists a Well Completions and Recompletions report; not opened

logs.n: Layer has only LOG_REVIEWED_FLAG; log documents not verified

production_link.n: HYPERLINK column opens the well profile, which shows monthly production (agency guide)

sources.tested: One grouped statistics query on layer 13 (PERMIT_DATE since 2025-11-01, grouped by OPERATION_TYPE_CODE, WELL_CLASS_TYPE_CODE, PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE): HTTP 200, 1.2 KB JSON: 173 permits, 12 months, newest permit 2026-10-13, all OPERATION_TYPE_CODE 01, no class code, product 00 on 145, gas 20 on 20, oil 10 on 8. Earlier saved responses from this machine (the service layer list, a 4-row sample, fill counts) gave the 86-field schema and show GIS_UPD_DATE 2026-10-31 09:05 UTC on the newest rows. The 304 recent permits in the fill counts used in the cell notes run from 2025-01-14 to 2026-10-13 (that filter was not recorded). maxRecordCount 1000 (32,000 without geometry); formats JSON, geoJSON, PBF; supports statistics, group-by and pagination.

grade_reason: Reachable, free ArcGIS layer with one row per well, PERMIT_DATE and SPUD_DATE, coordinates, depth and operator, so monthly counts of permits can be queried. Held to B, not A, because the layer has no usable work type (OPERATION_TYPE_CODE is 01 on every recent permit), the product code is 00 on 145 of 173 permits in the last year (so oil versus gas cannot be split at permit time), and only 173 permits a year appear, which may omit wells without coordinates (not checked against an agency total). The SONRIS portal that might fill gaps returned 504.
producer_plan: Query layer 13 with where PERMIT_DATE >= DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD', returnGeometry=false, and outFields WELL_SERIAL_NUM, API_NUM, PERMIT_DATE, SPUD_DATE, WELL_STATUS_CODE, LEGEND_DESC, PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, OPERATION_TYPE_CODE, WELL_CLASS_TYPE_CODE, PARISH_CODE, DISTRICT_CODE, FIELD_NAME, ORG_OPER_NAME, MEASURED_DEPTH, TRUE_VERTICAL_DEPTH, UNIT_WELL_FLAG; page with resultOffset (1,000 per page, or more without geometry). PERMIT_DATE is epoch milliseconds at local midnight (05:00 UTC in summer, 06:00 in winter): convert to America/Chicago before taking the month. Count rows per month as new-well permits; count a row as injection when WELL_CLASS_TYPE_CODE or the status code marks an injection or disposal well (check on real rows first). Re-entries (Redrill), repermits and amendments are not visible as separate rows. Cap or drop future SPUD_DATE values. Rows with status 03 (permit expired) stay in the layer, so count by PERMIT_DATE, not by current status. Compare one past month's count on two dates to learn whether rows are revised, and compare with the SONRIS Wells by Permit Date report when the portal answers. Refresh cadence unknown (GIS_UPD_DATE was one bulk stamp on 2026-10-31).
privacy_notes: The layer has business operator names (ORG_OPER_NAME, 40 characters; may include an individual or a dba), and two free-text fields (COMMENTS, SCOUT_DETAIL, up to 2,000 characters) that were not read: apply the tracker's nameable-operator rule and do not publish the free text. No phone or e-mail column in the schema. The blank form has contact-person fields, but they are not in the open data.
